text_simplified: The text speaks of an old story that shows the importance of tawakkul (reliance on Allah) together with taking the means. It relates that a man asked the Prophet ﷺ about leaving his camel untied, so he ﷺ replied that one must first tie the camel, then rely on Allah. The story teaches us that planning and hard work do not conflict with trust in Allah.
